default.notes: Visitor Visa required — apply online before travelling. The NZD 100 International Visitor Levy is charged with the application.

groups.notes: Visa waiver, but you must request an NZeTA before boarding (NZD 17 plus the NZD 100 International Visitor Levy). Stays of up to 3 months per visit.

NZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for New Zealand citizens.

AU.notes: Australian citizens do not need a visa or NZeTA under the Trans-Tasman Travel Arrangement — they can visit, live and work in New Zealand freely and are granted a resident visa on arrival.

GB.notes: Visa waiver with an extended stay: British citizens may remain up to 6 months per visit. An NZeTA (NZD 17 plus the NZD 100 International Visitor Levy) is still required before boarding.
